waterbubble.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

weakarmor.name: Weak Armor
weakarmor.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a physical move, its Defense stat is lowered by 1 stage, but its Speed stat is boosted by 2 stages.

whitesmoke.name: White Smoke
whitesmoke.desc: The Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

zerotohero.name: Zero to Hero
zerotohero.desc: The Pokémon changes into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.
